blocks.text: 我踏出家門
blocks.spelling: guá ta̍h-tshut ka-mn̂g

blocks.text: 家的門前是一片鳳梨園
blocks.spelling: tshù ê thâu-tsiân tio̍h sī ông-lâi hn̂g

blocks.text: 遠遠看去 沒半間7-11
blocks.spelling: hn̄g-hn̄g khuànn-khì bô puànn king 7-11

blocks.text: 只有阿婆的那間柑仔店
blocks.spelling: tsí-ū ah pô ê hit king kam-á tiàm

blocks.text: 我踏出家門
blocks.spelling: guá ta̍h-tshut mn̂g ka-mn̂g

blocks.text: 看到歐吉桑會互相借問
blocks.spelling: khuànn-tio̍h oo-jí-sáng ē hōo-siong tsioh-mn̄g

blocks.text: 每天的心情都非常歡喜
blocks.spelling: ta̍k-kang ê sim-tsîng lóng hui-siông huann-hí

blocks.text: 在這個大家都很善良的田庄
blocks.spelling: tī tsit-ê ta̍k-ke lóng tsin siān-liông ê tshân-tsng

blocks.text: 這片土地
blocks.spelling: tsit phìnn thóo-tē

blocks.text: 有我的背景 有我的來歷
blocks.spelling: ū guá ê puē-kíng ū guá ê lâi-li̍k

blocks.text: 從我出生就在這生活
blocks.spelling: tsiông guá tshut-sì tio̍h tī tsia sing-ua̍h

blocks.text: 這是我們最快樂的地方
blocks.spelling: tse sī lán siōng khuài-lo̍k ê sóo-tsāi

blocks.text: 不管它有多麼鄉下
blocks.spelling: m̄-kuán i ū guā-nī tsng-kha

blocks.text: 它永遠是我們的靠岸
blocks.spelling: i íng-uán sī lán ê khò-huānn
